cases.description: Verify that the protected method createSchemaValidatorsConfig() returns a non‑null SchemaValidatorsConfig object when invoked.

cases.expected: two distinct SchemaValidatorsConfig instances on successive calls
cases.description: Call createSchemaValidatorsConfig() twice and assert that the returned objects are not the same reference, confirming a fresh instance is created each time.

cases.expected: default configuration values (e.g., failFast == false, typeLoose == false, readOnly == false, ...)
cases.description: Inspect the newly created SchemaValidatorsConfig and verify that all its configurable flags retain the library‑defined default values.

cases.expected: modifying a flag on the first returned instance does not affect a second returned instance (both retain independent default values)
cases.description: Call createSchemaValidatorsConfig() twice, set failFast=true on the first instance, then assert that failFast on the second instance is still false, confirming that each call returns a fresh, independent object.

cases.expected: each thread receives a distinct SchemaValidatorsConfig instance (no shared references)
cases.description: Spawn several threads (e.g., 10) that each invoke createSchemaValidatorsConfig() on the same JsonSchemaFactory instance and store the result in a thread‑local list. After all threads complete, verify that the list contains only unique objects (size equals number of threads).

cases.expected: instances created from different JsonSchemaFactory objects are independent
cases.description: Create two separate JsonSchemaFactory objects, invoke createSchemaValidatorsConfig() on each, modify a flag on the config from the first factory, and assert that the config from the second factory still has the default flag value, proving no cross‑factory sharing.

cases.expected: non‑null SchemaValidatorsConfig instance obtained via reflection
cases.description: Use Java reflection to locate the protected method createSchemaValidatorsConfig() on JsonSchemaFactory, make it accessible, invoke it on a JsonSchemaFactory instance, and assert that the returned object is non‑null and of type com.networknt.schema.SchemaValidatorsConfig.
